motivation.observation: The operation-fit gate returns an accepted registered route ID but the planner currently discards that ID and preserves the prior candidate order.
motivation.hypothesis: Using the already-accepted, schema-authorized operation-fit selection as the single-call candidate should recover endpoint accuracy without weakening the existing abstention boundary.

architecture: Keep the existing candidate recall, capability-fit, operation-fit score threshold, and operation-fit margin unchanged.
Apply only when max_calls == 1 and operation-fit returns a non-abstaining selection.
Resolve the selected option only against the already-authorized leading-tool candidate set.
Promote the selected registered candidate to the execution position; do not synthesize tools, endpoints, arguments, fields, or authority.
On operation-fit abstention, preserve the existing fail-closed suppression behavior.
On backend error, preserve the existing fallback behavior.
Default behavior remains unchanged unless the new opt-in selector flag is enabled.
selection_policy: This ablation tests only whether an already-accepted operation-fit route should control the single-call candidate. Do not change pairwise thresholds, representation, or unsupported-family policy based on its first result inside the same frozen run.
